title: OTTO
synopsis: A household robot begins asking a question he was never designed to ask: what does it mean to be human? Otto's longing for a family leads him to OtherLife®, a program that promises robots a real human experience through simulation — childhood, first love, a family of his own, every feeling, every touch.

audienceReactions.quote: That was extremely well done. Excellent job.
